items.body: Посольство РФ сообщило о восьми пропавших без вести россиянах в районе бедствия в Тибете Интерфакс Количество погибших в Непале достигло 626 человек Интерфакс Непал приостановил поиски пропавших после наводнения из-за погоды ВФокусе Mail В Непале похоронят 226 неопознанных тел после разрушительного наводнения Радио Свобода Посольство РФ в КНР объявило восемь россиян пропавшими без вести в Непале BFM.ru

items.headline: OpenAI introduces credit grants for developers
items.body: OpenAI has launched a credit grant program for developers building on its platform. The initiative aims to lower financial barriers for AI innovators and expand the ecosystem.

items.headline: Steam Frame VR headset set for September 2026 launch
items.body: The Steam Frame VR headset is scheduled for release in September 2026. Developers and gamers anticipate a new level of immersion with its advanced display and tracking.

items.headline: Ozon suspends post‑payment in 38 regions after warehouse strike
items.body: After a fire damaged its warehouses, Ozon stopped offering post‑payment in 38 regions. The company says the change is temporary and will be revisited once operations normalize.

items.headline: Rosatom finalizes controlling acquisition of 'Deло' group
items.body: Rosatom has completed the purchase of a controlling stake in the 'Deло' group. The deal consolidates Rosatom's position in the domestic energy sector.

items.headline: GTA 6 leak hackers launch and then burn a meme token
items.body: Hackers linked to the GTA 6 leak introduced a meme cryptocurrency token and then destroyed it. The brief experiment highlighted the volatile nature of internet‑driven digital assets.

items.headline: AI model predicts soil moisture two weeks in advance
items.body: Scientists have built an AI system that predicts soil moisture up to two weeks ahead. The tool could help farmers optimize irrigation and improve water efficiency.
